name: Hylo Open
stakes: This week offers a golden opportunity for India's badminton contingent to secure significant titles, with PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen both vying for Super 500 glory in Saarbrücken.
summary: India's campaign at the Hylo Open has culminated in a thrilling Sunday, with two of its brightest stars, PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen, reaching their respective finals. Sindhu, seeded eighth, navigated a challenging draw, including an all-Indian semifinal clash against Anmol Kharb, to set up a title showdown against Denmark's Line Højmark Kjaersfeldt. This marks a crucial opportunity for Sindhu to clinch her first title of the season in Europe, and her second overall for 2026. Lakshya Sen has also impressed, battling his way to the men's singles final where he faces Indonesia's formidable Jonatan Christie. Sen is eager to secure his first title of the year, showcasing a strong return to form. While the focus now shifts to these two high-stakes finals, other Indian hopefuls like Satwik & Chirag, Treesa & Gayatri, HS Prannoy, and Malvika Bansod saw earlier exits from the Super 500 event.
